title: Unregistered hospital owner, aides beat man to death in Bihar for protesting poor care; 2 held

ai.summary: Police said an unregistered hospital owner and his aides beat a man to death in Bihar after he protested poor care for his pregnant daughter, leading to two arrests and a health department inquiry.

facts.claim: an unregistered hospital owner and his aides beat a man to death in Bihar after he protested poor care for his pregnant daughter
facts.quote: A man died after being allegedly battered with a baseball bat and iron rods by the owner of an unregistered private hospital and his aides in Bihar's Aurangabad district for protesting the inadequate treatment of a pregnant woman, police said on Tuesday.
Two men were nabbed on November 12, following the incident at K P Memorial Hospital in Rafiganj, they said.
Aurangabad civil surgeon said the incident prompted the health department to launch an inquiry into the affairs of the hospital, and it was found that the facility was not a registered one.

ai.background_note: The incident involved an unregistered hospital in Bihar where a man died after being beaten by the owner for protesting inadequate care for his pregnant daughter, prompting a health department inquiry and police action.
